learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the information processes between supply and demand since the Industrial Revolution.
Students understand the historical dimension of the phenomenon of consumption in the modern era.

Students understand today through the concept of consumption with new consumption patterns, consumer groups, globalization and consumption, fluidity of desires, and identity definitions through consumption.
Students learn the terminology of consumption in the modern world.
Students learn to prepare an assignment at an academic level.

syllabus_topics: Consumption in the Modern Era I
Consumption in the Modern Era II
